slides.title: Welcome to Web APIs
slides.content:
# JavaScript Web APIs 🌐

Web APIs extend JavaScript beyond the core language, allowing web applications to communicate with remote servers, store persistent data on the client device, and interact with device hardware like GPS.

## What you'll master:
- 📡 **The Fetch API** - Making HTTP requests (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE)
- 🗄️ **Web Storage** - `localStorage` vs `sessionStorage` vs Cookies
- 📍 **Geolocation API** - Reading coordinates and tracking device location
- 🔒 **Permissions & Security** - Managing user consent and HTTPS requirements
- 🚀 **Modern Web Capabilities** - Clipboard API, Notifications, and AbortController

slides.content:
# Web Storage: `localStorage` vs `sessionStorage` 🗄️

Both APIs store key-value string data directly in the user's browser:

| Feature | `localStorage` | `sessionStorage` | Cookies |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Capacity** | ~5MB - 10MB | ~5MB | ~4KB |
| **Expiration** | Never (Persistent until cleared) | Cleared when browser tab closes | Configurable expiration |
| **Server Transfer** | Never sent to server | Never sent to server | Sent automatically with every HTTP request |
| **Access** | Same-Origin only | Same-Origin & Same Tab | Configurable domain/path |

slides.content:
# Storage Security: Never Store Tokens in localStorage ⚠️

Why should you **never** store sensitive auth tokens (like session JWTs) in `localStorage`?

- **XSS Vulnerability:** Any script running on your page (including third-party analytics, ads, or compromised npm packages) has direct, unrestricted access to `localStorage.getItem("token")`!
- **Safe Alternative:** Store authentication tokens in **`HttpOnly` cookies** which cannot be accessed by client-side JavaScript!

slides.content:
# JavaScript APIs Mastered! 🌟

You now have the power to integrate servers, persistent client storage, and device capabilities into your web apps!

## Key Takeaways:
- ✅ **Fetch API:** Make asynchronous HTTP requests; remember to check `response.ok`.
- ✅ **Request Cancellation:** Use `AbortController` for timeouts and cancellation.
- ✅ **`localStorage`:** Persist key-value string data; serialize objects with `JSON.stringify`.
- ✅ **Geolocation:** Access GPS coordinates via `navigator.geolocation` over HTTPS.
- ✅ **Clipboard API:** Copy code snippets seamlessly with `navigator.clipboard.writeText()`.

## Congratulations!
You have completed the entire **JavaScript Learning Curriculum**! Ready to add compile-time type safety with **TypeScript**? Let's go! 🚀
